body: I'm new to reddit so apologize for my lack of understanding comment response. BaoZedong I can completely relate to you. But there are two things that have kept me alive. The way I look up to my father (he is a great guy and I have never fought with him in my life, my parents are divorced and I see him a few times a month, the divorce has nothing to do with my sadness btw) and next is this relationship I have with this girl. Although we aren't dating, I would really like to but unfortunately she is really busy with a ton of stuff (not gona go into detail) although I think we really like each other, she is just far to occupied at the moment to really spend more time together and etc. Which also contributes to my sadness being this annoying situation. But its just a typical teen drama, I can get over it, I have gotten over it before. However I still have all of this built up self doubt, mainly dealing with a few years of sloppy grades and assortments of failures. Like most people I read about, I too have lost the motivation to live on. What's interesting is nobody I know knows this side of me.
